insight.headline: Storefront API 2027-01: ask `storeAvailability` for physical storefronts with `physicalStorefront: true`
insight.what_changed: Storefront API version 2027-01 lets you ask ProductVariant.storeAvailability for walk-in storefront locations with a new physicalStorefront argument, without changing existing pickup behavior. Apps that query storeAvailability can now include or exclude storefronts explicitly, and no one needs to update existing queries.
